history_english: Kasba Ganpati is the Gramdevata (presiding deity) of Pune — the highest honour any Ganpati can hold. The swayambhu (self-originated) idol was found near the home of Vinayak Thakar, close to where Jijabai, mother of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, resided. After Dadoji Kondev reported the discovery, Jijabai ordered the temple's construction in 1639. It is believed Shivaji Maharaj never set out for battle without first seeking blessings here. The idol was originally the size of a grain of rice; centuries of red sandalwood paste applied by devotees have caused it to grow. Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak formally declared Kasba Ganpati as Gramdevata and gave it the first position in the Manacha order when public Ganeshotsav began in 1893. On Visarjan day, no other mandal may begin its procession until Kasba Ganpati is immersed.
history_marathi: कसबा गणपती हे पुण्याचे ग्रामदैवत असून सर्व गणेश मंडळांमध्ये सर्वोच्च मानाचे स्थान आहे. हे स्वयंभू दैवत विनायक ठाकर यांच्या घराजवळ, जिजाबाईंच्या निवासाजवळ सापडले. दादोजी कोंडदेव यांनी जिजाबाईंना सांगितल्यावर त्यांनी १६३९ मध्ये मंदिर बांधण्याचा आदेश दिला. छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज स्वारीला निघण्यापूर्वी येथे दर्शन घेत असत. मूर्ती सुरुवातीला तांदळाच्या दाण्याएवढी होती; भक्तांनी लावलेल्या रक्तचंदनामुळे आकाराने मोठी झाली. लोकमान्य टिळकांनी १८९३ मध्ये पहिला मान दिला. विसर्जनाच्या दिवशी कसबा गणपतीचे विसर्जन होईपर्यंत इतर मंडळे विसर्जनास सुरुवात करत नाहीत.

history_english: Tambdi Jogeshwari is primarily a temple of Goddess Jogeshwari — the Gramdevi (guardian goddess) of Pune — distinct from Kasba Ganpati which is the Gramdevata. The Durga temple dates back to the 15th century, making it one of Pune's oldest religious sites. Ganeshotsav here began in 1893 introduced by Bhau Bhendre, coinciding with Tilak's launch of Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav. Tilak gave this mandal the honour of second place. What makes this mandal unique among the Manache five: the Ganpati idol is immersed every year and a fresh idol is installed the following year. Since 2000, the idol is placed in a stunning silver dome pandal erected outside the temple — now one of the most recognisable sights of Pune's Ganeshotsav. The idol itself is described as having a distinctive reddish hue.

history_english: Guruji Talim Ganpati was established in 1887 — six years before Lokmanya Tilak launched Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav — making it one of Pune's very first public Ganesh mandals. It was founded jointly by Bhiku Shinde (Hindu) and Ustad Nalban (Muslim), a powerful symbol of communal harmony at a time of political tension. Since 1987 the mandal has self-funded all celebrations without public donations, a century-long tradition of self-reliance. The mandal is widely credited with originating the dhol-tasha (drum and cymbal) procession tradition during Ganeshotsav — a practice now inseparable from the festival's identity across Maharashtra. Tilak gave this mandal third place in the Manacha order.

history_english: Tulshibaug Ganpati was established in 1901 by Aba Khatavkar, Sadashiv Pawar, and Boloba Walke in the heart of one of Pune's oldest bazaars — Tulshibaug market. The mandal made history in 1975 as the first mandal in Pune to install a fibreglass idol, crafted by artist D.S. Khatavkar. The current idol stands 13 feet tall and is adorned with silver ornaments weighing over 80 kilograms. Evening aartis draw enormous crowds and the narrow lanes of Tulshibaug packed with devotees are an unforgettable sight. The market surrounding the mandal is one of the best places to experience the authentic energy of Ganeshotsav.

history_english: Kesariwada Ganpati is directly linked to India's freedom struggle. Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak installed this Ganpati in 1893 at Vinchurkar Wada to launch Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav — the movement that transformed a private ritual into a mass community celebration and vehicle for political awakening against British rule. In 1905 the festival shifted to Kesariwada (Gaikwad Wada), Tilak's personal residence and the headquarters of the Kesari newspaper. Inside, a Tilak museum holds the historic palanquin used in the Ganpati procession. A statue of Tilak stands behind the idol. The Kesari Trust deliberately spends little on decoration, focusing on lectures, cultural events, and community programs that bring people together.

history_english: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati is arguably the most famous Ganesh temple in all of Maharashtra and among the most visited religious sites in India. It was founded in 1893 by Shreemant Dagdusheth Halwai — a prosperous sweet merchant originally from Satara — and his wife Lakshmibai, after they lost their son to the plague epidemic. The temple's trust has grown into one of the richest religious trusts in India, funding an old age home, orphanage, ambulance services for the poor, health clinics in tribal areas, and cooperative banks. The iconic 7.5-foot tall idol was commissioned in 1968 to mark the temple's 75th anniversary and crafted by Shree Shankar Appa Shilpi. It is adorned with approximately 8 kilograms of gold and precious gems. During Ganeshotsav, over 1.5 million devotees visit. Celebrities and politicians across India make it a point to seek blessings here.

history_english: Sarasbaug Ganpati, also known as Talyatla Ganpati (Ganpati of the lake), is one of Pune's most beloved Ganesh temples. Built during the Peshwa era in the 18th century, it houses the idol of Shree Siddhivinayak — the wish-fulfilling form of Ganesha. The temple is set within the 25-acre Sarasbaug complex, which was originally an artificial lake created during the Peshwa period and later converted into a garden park by the PMC in the 1960s. On an average day 10,000 devotees visit; on Ganesh Chaturthi this reaches 80,000. The scenic garden surroundings make this one of Pune's most peaceful darshan experiences.
history_marathi: सारसबाग सिद्धिविनायक — तळ्यातला गणपती — हे पुण्यातील अत्यंत प्रिय गणेश मंदिर आहे. पेशवे काळात १८ व्या शतकात बांधलेले हे मंदिर २५ एकर सारसबाग संकुलात आहे. दररोज सरासरी १०,००० भाविक येतात, गणेश चतुर्थीला ८०,०००. एकेकाळी कृत्रिम तलाव असलेले हे ठिकाण आता सुंदर बागेत रूपांतरित झाले आहे. श्री सिद्धिविनायक — इच्छापूर्ती करणारा गणपती.

history_english: Tambat Ali Ganpati — officially known as Shrimant Bhausaheb Rangari Ganpati — is considered the first sarvajanik (public) Ganesha celebration in India, predating Tilak's formal launch of Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav in 1893. It was established in 1892 by Bhausaheb Laxman Javle (known as Bhau Rangari), a royal physician (Rajvaidya) and freedom movement sympathiser. Bhausaheb had witnessed a traditional public Ganesha celebration in Gwalior (then ruled by Marathas) and brought the concept to Pune. The idol is unique: it depicts Ganesha killing a demon, symbolising the victory of good over evil — directly reflecting Bhausaheb's desire for India's freedom. The wooden idol has never been changed since the day it was installed in 1892.
history_marathi: तांबट आळी गणपती — श्रीमंत भाऊसाहेब रंगारी गणपती — हे भारतातील पहिले सार्वजनिक गणेश मंडळ मानले जाते. १८९२ मध्ये भाऊसाहेब लक्ष्मण जावले (भाऊ रंगारी) यांनी स्थापना केली. भाऊसाहेब ग्वाल्हेरमधील सार्वजनिक उत्सव पाहून ही कल्पना पुण्यात आणली. मूर्ती अनोखी आहे — गणपती राक्षसाचा वध करताना दाखवलेला आहे. हीच लाकडाची मूर्ती १८९२ पासून आजही कायम आहे, कधीही बदलली नाही.
significance_short: India's first sarvajanik Ganeshotsav mandal (1892). Unique idol shows Ganesha slaying a demon — symbol of freedom struggle. Same original wooden idol since 1892, never replaced.

history_english: Twasta Kasar Ganpati holds a distinctive honour in Pune's Ganeshotsav — it is the sixth mandal in the immersion procession, immediately after the Manache Panch. This position is officially recognised and remains consistent year after year, making it effectively a 'sixth Manacha' in practice. The mandal is named after the Twasta Kasar community — skilled brass and copper craftsmen (kasars) — who are historically associated with Kasba Peth. The mandal is known for elaborate replica pandals recreating famous temples or monuments such as the Shore Temple of Mahabalipuram.

history_english: Hatti Ganpati Mandal in Sadashiv Peth is well known across Pune for its varied and creative themed decorations. The name 'Hatti' refers to elephants, and the mandal has historically featured elephants or elephant-related themes in its decorations and processions. The mandal is located on Hatti Ganpati Road in Sadashiv Peth and has built a loyal following among Punekars for its energetic and visually spectacular celebrations. It is a regular fixture on must-visit lists for Pune Ganeshotsav.

history_english: Chhatrapati Rajaram Mandal is one of Pune's oldest and most celebrated Sarvajanik Ganesh mandals. It is famous across Maharashtra for its extraordinary pandal decorations — every year, skilled artisans recreate famous temples, monuments, or cultural landmarks from across India. The craftsmanship is considered among the finest in Pune, drawing tens of thousands of visitors specifically for the visual spectacle. The mandal is named in honour of Chhatrapati Rajaram Maharaj, son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
history_marathi: छत्रपती राजाराम मंडळ हे पुण्यातील सर्वात जुन्या आणि प्रसिद्ध सार्वजनिक मंडळांपैकी एक आहे. दरवर्षी भारतातील प्रसिद्ध मंदिरे किंवा स्थळांची हुबेहूब प्रतिकृती मंडपात उभारली जाते. मंडळाचे नाव छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराजांचे पुत्र छत्रपती राजाराम महाराज यांच्या सन्मानार्थ.
significance_short: Best known pandal in Pune — recreates famous Indian temples as pandal theme every year. Named after Chhatrapati Rajaram Maharaj. Artistic excellence is its hallmark.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol within spectacular replica temple or monument pandal — a new architectural marvel every year.
mandir_address: 871, Sadashiv Peth Road, Perugate, Sadashiv Peth, Pune 411030
special_events: Pandal inauguration event; photography-friendly spectacular replica; cultural performances; social programs

history_english: Hutatma Babu Genu Ganesh Mandal was established in 1970 by seven young men from Mandai, named in honour of Babu Genu Said — a mill worker who was martyred in 1930 when he lay down in front of a British truck carrying foreign cloth to block it. The mandal is Pune's most famous 'Navsacha Ganpati' — devotees believe sincere wishes made here are granted. A unique 'navsachi vihir' (wish well/pond) allows devotees to throw coins and make wishes. Each year the pandal recreates iconic monuments. The idol is adorned with gold, diamond, and silver ornaments.
history_marathi: हुतात्मा बाबू गेनू गणेश मंडळाची स्थापना १९७० मध्ये मंडईतील सात तरुणांनी केली. हे मंडळ स्वातंत्र्यसेनानी बाबू गेनू साईद यांच्या स्मरणार्थ आहे, ज्यांनी १९३० मध्ये परदेशी कापड घेऊन जाणाऱ्या ट्रकसमोर झोपून आत्मबलिदान केले. पुण्याचा 'नवसाचा गणपती' म्हणून प्रसिद्ध. 'नवसाची विहीर' मध्ये नाणे टाकून मनोकामना मागता येते.
significance_short: Pune's beloved Navsacha Ganpati (wish-fulfilling). Named after martyred freedom fighter Babu Genu. Unique wish well (navsachi vihir). Temple-replica pandals every year.
idol_description: Beautifully adorned idol with gold, diamond, and silver ornaments. Distinctive Puneri pagadi (traditional turban) on the idol.
mandir_address: Near Martyr Babu Genu Chowk, Mandai, Budhwar Peth, Pune 411002
special_events: Wish well (navsachi vihir) open throughout; replica monument pandal; anniversary programs for Babu Genu

history_english: Akhil Mandai Mandal is famous for two things: the exceptional beauty of its Ganpati idol — known as the Sharda Ganpati — and consistently high-quality pandal decorations. The Sharda Ganpati idol is widely considered one of the most visually beautiful Ganesh idols in Pune, and devotees make the trip specifically to see the artistry of the murti. The mandal is also known for social reform events, cultural programs, and community initiatives. Located near Mandai market, it benefits from very high footfall throughout the festival.
history_marathi: अखिल मंडई मंडळातील 'शारदा गणपती' मूर्ती पुण्यातील सर्वात सुंदर मूर्तींपैकी एक मानली जाते. भव्य मंडप सजावट आणि सामाजिक उपक्रमांसाठीही ओळखले जाते. मंडईजवळ असल्याने गर्दी नेहमी जास्त.
significance_short: Sharda Ganpati — one of Pune's most beautiful idol craftsmanships. Grand pandal. Strong social programs. High footfall due to Mandai market location.
idol_description: Sharda Ganpati — celebrated for artistic beauty and fine craftsmanship. One of the most visually striking murtis in Pune.
mandir_address: Near Mandai Market, Shukrawar Peth, Pune 411002
special_events: Social reform events; cultural programs; community social work during 10 days

history_english: Natu Baug Ganpati is one of Pune's most famous mandals for its spectacular light displays and immersive visual experience. The mandal is a perennial crowd favourite known for state-of-the-art lighting arrangements, elaborate themed pandals, and immersive experiences. The name 'Natu Baug' refers to the garden (baug) of the Natu family near which the mandal historically operated. It regularly features in must-visit lists and is particularly popular with younger generations and families.
history_marathi: नातू बाग गणपती हे भव्य लाइट शो आणि आकर्षक सजावटीसाठी प्रसिद्ध आहे. दरवर्षी अत्याधुनिक दिव्यांचे प्रदर्शन आणि थीमॅटिक मंडप तयार केला जातो. 'नातू बाग' हे नाव नातू कुटुंबाच्या बागेवरून आले आहे. तरुण पिढी आणि कुटुंबांमध्ये विशेष लोकप्रिय.
significance_short: Pune's most famous mandal for spectacular light displays and immersive pandal. Perennial crowd favourite. Go-to for families and younger visitors.
idol_description: Traditional idol in extraordinary visual setting. Natu Baug is about the full sensory experience — pandal and lighting are the main draw alongside darshan.
mandir_address: Sadashiv Peth, Pune 411030 (exact address — confirm with locals near Sadashiv Peth)
special_events: Light shows every evening; themed immersive pandal; cultural programs

area: Near Shaniwarwada, Kasba Peth / Shanipar, Pune
history_english: Shanipar Ganpati is situated near the iconic Shaniwarwada fort — the former seat of the Peshwa empire — giving this mandal a unique historical setting. Popular among tourists exploring Shaniwarwada who combine their heritage visit with Ganpati darshan. The mandal is known for live plays on current social issues (Jeevant Dekhavas) and larger-than-life replica displays. Located at Shanipar Chowk on Bajirao Road.
history_marathi: शनिपार गणपती ऐतिहासिक शनिवारवाड्याजवळ आहे. बाजीराव रोडवरील शनिपार चौकात स्थित. 'जीवंत देखावा' (जिवंत नाटक) साठी प्रसिद्ध. शनिवारवाड्याला भेट देणारे पर्यटक येथे दर्शन घेतात.
significance_short: Steps from Shaniwarwada. Known for live plays (Jeevant Dekhavas) on social issues. Heritage location gives unique gravitas. Natural stop for tourists doing old Pune.
idol_description: Traditional idol near Pune's most iconic historical monument. Location is inseparable from identity.
mandir_address: Shanipar Chowk, Bajirao Road, Kasba Peth, Pune 411011
special_events: Live play (Jeevant Dekhavas) on social themes; close to Shaniwarwada light and sound show; traditional petha processions

food.name: Ramnath Misal
food.type: near Sahitya Parishad, Tilak Rd, hot spicy misal

history_english: Jilbya Maruti Ganpati is a beloved mandal in Tulshibaug, located near the famous Jilbya Maruti temple — named for the jalebis (jilbyas) traditionally offered to Hanuman here. The mandal is part of the natural darshan circuit through Tulshibaug lanes, often visited alongside the 4th Manacha (Tulshibaug Ganpati), Guruji Talim, and Tambdi Jogeshwari. The Tulshibaug-Dagdusheth corridor sees some of the highest footfall in Pune during the 10 days. Also known locally as Navasacha Ganpati for its wish-fulfilling reputation.
history_marathi: जिलब्या मारुती गणपती हे तुळशीबागेतील प्रिय मंडळ आहे. जिलब्या मारुती मंदिराजवळ आहे — जिथे हनुमानाला जिलब्या अर्पण करण्याची परंपरा आहे. तुळशीबाग-दगडूशेठ परिसर गणेशोत्सवात सर्वाधिक गर्दीचा असतो. नवसाचा गणपती म्हणूनही ओळखले जाते.
significance_short: Part of the high-footfall Tulshibaug darshan circuit. Near Jilbya Maruti temple (named for jalebi offerings to Hanuman). Also known as local Navsacha Ganpati.
idol_description: Traditional Ganesh idol in the famous Tulshibaug lanes. Location in the festival's busiest corridor is its defining feature.
mandir_address: Near Jilbya Maruti Temple, Tulshibaug Internal Road, Budhwar Peth, Pune 411002
special_events: Part of dense Tulshibaug darshan corridor; traditional aarti; high-energy atmosphere

history_english: Navjawan Mitra Mandal in Sadashiv Peth is famous for erecting some of the tallest festival displays in Pune — they once built a 122-foot-high display of Krishna slaying a demon. The mandal is also known for large-scale live plays (Jeevant Dekhavas) on themes from Indian history and mythology, including productions like Shivrajyabhishek with 30+ artists. It is a go-to mandal for visitors who want drama and scale.
history_marathi: नवजवान मित्र मंडळ सदाशिव पेठेत आहे आणि पुण्यातील सर्वात उंच देखाव्यांसाठी प्रसिद्ध आहे. एकदा ते १२२ फूट उंच कृष्ण-राक्षस देखावा उभारला होता. भव्य जीवंत नाटकांसाठीही ओळखले जाते.
significance_short: Famous for Pune's tallest festival displays (once 122 feet). Live plays with large artist casts. High drama and scale makes it a must-visit for spectacle.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol within towering themed displays — scale is the hallmark.
mandir_address: Sadashiv Peth, near Perugate, Pune 411030
special_events: Tallest festival display in Pune; large-scale live historical plays; cultural extravaganza

history_english: Vishrambag Wada Ganpati is based near the historic Vishrambag Wada — a sprawling Peshwa-era palace built by Peshwa Baji Rao II in the early 19th century. The Wada is one of the most architecturally significant surviving Peshwa structures in Pune. The mandal is known for live plays (Jeevant Dekhavas) on current and historical themes. The presence of the Wada gives this mandal a powerful heritage backdrop during the festival.
history_marathi: विश्रामबाग वाडा गणपती ऐतिहासिक विश्रामबाग वाड्याजवळ आहे — पेशवे बाजीराव दुसरे यांनी बांधलेला प्रसिद्ध वाडा. जीवंत देखाव्यांसाठी ओळखले जाते.
significance_short: Near historic Peshwa-era Vishrambag Wada. Live plays on historical/current themes. Heritage backdrop.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol near the architecturally significant Vishrambag Wada.
mandir_address: Near Vishrambag Wada, Bajirao Road, Sadashiv Peth, Pune 411030
special_events: Live plays (Jeevant Dekhavas); heritage architecture of Wada as backdrop

history_english: Nimbalkar Talim Ganpati in Sadashiv Peth is famous for its 'Halta Dekhavas' — mechanised displays of mythological tales where figures move and scenes animate. These moving tableau displays are a rare and much-loved tradition in Pune, and Nimbalkar Talim is one of the best exponents of this art. The mandal is located near the famous Chimnya Ganpati in Sadashiv Peth.
history_marathi: निंबाळकर तालीम गणपती 'हलता देखावा' — यांत्रिक चलत्चित्र देखाव्यांसाठी प्रसिद्ध आहे. पौराणिक कथांचे सचल दृश्य हे या मंडळाचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे. सदाशिव पेठेतील चिम्न्या गणपतीजवळ आहे.
significance_short: Famous for Halta Dekhavas — rare mechanised moving tableau displays of mythological stories. One of the best of this dying tradition in Pune.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol alongside mechanised moving mythological tableau displays.
mandir_address: Near Chimnya Ganapati, Sadashiv Peth, Pune 411030
special_events: Halta Dekhavas (mechanised moving tableau); mythological tableau displays; traditional celebration

area: Ganesh Peth, near Laxmi Road, Pune
history_english: Jotyachi Talim Ganpati is located in Ganesh Peth near Dulya Maruti on Laxmi Road. The mandal is known for impressive replica displays — they once recreated the 12 Jyotirlingas of India within the same pandal alongside a Kedarnath Temple replica. The mandal is named after the Jotya talim (training gymnasium) associated with it — 'talim' refers to traditional Marathi wrestling gymnasiums that often had community Ganpati mandals attached.
history_marathi: जोत्याची तालीम गणपती गणेश पेठेत, लक्ष्मी रोडवरील दुल्या मारुतीजवळ आहे. केदारनाथ मंदिराची प्रतिकृती आणि भारताच्या १२ ज्योतिर्लिंगांची प्रतिकृती एकाच मंडपात उभारण्यासाठी ओळखले जाते. 'तालीम' हे पारंपरिक मराठी कुस्ती व्यायामशाळेचे नाव आहे.
significance_short: Famous for recreating 12 Jyotirlingas and major temples in one pandal. Talim (wrestling gymnasium) community roots. Near Laxmi Road.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol in elaborate multi-temple replica pandal.
mandir_address: Near Dulya Maruti, Ganesh Peth, Laxmi Road, Pune 411002
special_events: Multi-temple replica pandal; Jyotirlinga displays; community athletic programs

area: Near Alka Talkies, Laxmi Road, Budhwar Peth, Pune
history_english: Garud Ganpati Mandal is located at the far end of Laxmi Road near Alka Talkies, close to the Guruji Talim Mandal (3rd Manacha). The mandal is known for visually creative cave and cavern themed displays (Ventaye Leni style). It takes its Visarjan procession jointly with Gajanan Mandal on a single rath (chariot), which is a distinctive and popular sight during immersion.
history_marathi: गरुड गणपती मंडळ लक्ष्मी रोडच्या अल्का टॉकीजजवळ आहे. गुहा-शैलीतील (वेंतये लेणी प्रकार) सजावटीसाठी ओळखले जाते. गजानन मंडळासोबत एकाच रथावर विसर्जन मिरवणूक काढते — हे एक वैशिष्ट्यपूर्ण दृश्य आहे.
significance_short: Near Alka Talkies, Laxmi Road. Cave-themed pandal displays. Unique joint Visarjan procession with Gajanan Mandal on a single chariot.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol within cave and cavern styled themed displays.
mandir_address: Near Alka Talkies, Laxmi Road, Budhwar Peth, Pune 411002
special_events: Cave-themed pandal; unique joint Visarjan rath with Gajanan Mandal; Laxmi Road procession spectacle

year_established: 18th century (Peshwa era — built by Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao / Nana Saheb)
history_english: The Parvati Hill temple complex was built by Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao (Nana Saheb) in the 18th century. It is one of Pune's oldest heritage structures, sitting atop a hillock at approximately 2,100 feet above sea level. The complex includes separate temples of Parvati, Devdeveshwar, Vishnu, Kartikeya, and a Ganesh shrine. The Peshwas used the hill as a vantage point and place of worship before campaigns. Devotees climb 103 steps to reach the complex. The Ganesh shrine offers a 360-degree panoramic view of Pune on clear days including Shaniwar Wada, Sinhagad Fort, and Pune University. A pre-Peshwa Buddhist cave exists halfway up the hill.
history_marathi: पार्वती टेकडीवरील मंदिर संकुल पेशवा बाळाजी बाजीराव (नानासाहेब) यांनी १८ व्या शतकात बांधले. समुद्रसपाटीपासून सुमारे २,१०० फूट उंचीवर आहे. पार्वती, देवदेवेश्वर, विष्णू, कार्तिकेय आणि गणेश मंदिरे आहेत. १०३ पायऱ्या चढाव्या लागतात. पुण्याचे विहंगम दृश्य दिसते. टेकडीच्या अर्ध्यावर पूर्व-पेशवे काळातील बौद्ध लेणी आहे.
significance_short: Peshwa-era hilltop temple with panoramic Pune views. 103 steps. Ganesh shrine in complex with Parvati, Vishnu, Kartikeya. Buddhist cave halfway up. One of Pune's oldest heritage sites.
idol_description: Traditional Ganesh idol in compact shrine within the Parvati temple complex. The panoramic view from the hilltop is what makes darshan here unforgettable.
mandir_address: Parvati Hill, Parvati Gaon, Pune 411009 (103 steps from the base)
pandal_address: Permanent temple — darshan at the temple itself; no separate pandal
special_events: Sunrise darshan on Chaturthi morning draws large crowds; photography — panoramic views; Buddhist cave exploration

history_english: Dashabhuja Ganapati on Karve Road is a Peshwa-era temple with a rare distinction: the idol has the trunk resting on the right side (Dakshinabhimukhi or Vamamukhi right-trunk form), considered far more sacred and auspicious than the common left-trunk idols found in most Ganesh temples. The word 'Dashabhuja' means ten-armed. The temple was once the property of Sardar Haripant Phadke, a senior Peshwa Sardar, and later donated to the Peshwas. It is one of very few temples in Pune with a right-trunk Ganesh. A small Hanuman shrine is also present.
history_marathi: दशभुज गणपती मंदिर कर्वे रोडवर आहे. येथील गणपतीची सोंड उजव्या बाजूला आहे (दक्षिणाभिमुखी) — डाव्या सोंडेपेक्षा अधिक पवित्र मानली जाते. 'दशभुज' म्हणजे दहा हात. हे मंदिर पेशव्यांचे सरदार हरिपंत फडके यांच्या मालकीचे होते आणि नंतर पेशव्यांना हुंडा म्हणून दिले गेले.
significance_short: Rare right-trunk (Dakshinabhimukhi) Ganesha — considered far more sacred than the common left-trunk. Ten-armed deity. Peshwa-era temple once owned by Sardar Haripant Phadke.
idol_description: Ten-armed (Dashabhuja) idol with rare right-trunk position. Right-trunk Ganesh is found in very few temples across Maharashtra — this is one of Pune's most significant.
mandir_address: Erandwane, Karve Road, Pune 411004 (near Paud Phata flyover)
special_events: Special significance on Chaturthi; right-trunk darshan considered very auspicious; heritage architecture

area: Ganeshkhind, near Savitribai Phule Pune University, Pune
history_english: Parvati Nandan Ganpati, also known as Khinditla Ganpati (Ganpati of the mountain pass), is a 17th-century temple in the Ganeshkhind area near Savitribai Phule Pune University. The word 'khind' means gorge or mountain pass in Marathi. This temple was historically situated at the northwestern boundary of old Pune. It is believed to have been restored by Rajmata Jijabai during the Maratha period. A further restoration in the Peshwa era is associated with a legend of a treasure found in the temple's well. 'Parvati Nandan' is one of Lord Ganesha's names.
history_marathi: पार्वती नंदन गणपती — खिंडीतला गणपती — हे पुणे विद्यापीठाजवळील गणेशखिंड परिसरात आहे. हे १७ व्या शतकातील मंदिर जुन्या पुण्याची वायव्य सीमा मानल्या जाणाऱ्या खिंडीत आहे. जिजाबाईंनी जीर्णोद्धार केल्याचे सांगितले जाते. पेशवे काळात विहिरीत खजिना सापडल्याची आख्यायिका आहे.
significance_short: 17th-century temple at Pune's historic northwestern boundary. Believed restored by Jijabai. Hidden gem known to history enthusiasts. Treasure legend from Peshwa era.
idol_description: Ancient stone idol in compact traditional temple. One of Pune's oldest Ganesh shrines — simplicity and antiquity are what make darshan here special.
mandir_address: Ganeshkhind, near Savitribai Phule Pune University, Senapati Bapat Road, Pune 411007
pandal_address: Permanent temple — darshan at the temple itself
special_events: Quiet heritage darshan — ideal for history enthusiasts; hidden gem not known to most tourists

history_english: Peshwe Ganpati is a historic Ganesh temple located along the ramparts of Shaniwarwada at its south-eastern corner. The Shaniwarwada gate adjacent to this temple is called the Ganesh Darwaja (Ganesh Gate) — named after this very temple. In Peshwa-era records the temple is referred to as the Ganpati at the 'Juna Sarkar Wada'. The temple's proximity to Shaniwarwada — the nerve centre of the Maratha Confederacy — makes it one of the most historically significant Ganesh sites in Pune.
history_marathi: पेशवे गणपती शनिवारवाड्याच्या तटबंदीवर, आग्नेय कोपऱ्यात आहे. शेजारचा शनिवारवाड्याचा दरवाजा 'गणेश दरवाजा' नावाने ओळखला जातो. पेशवे काळातील नोंदींमध्ये हे 'जुन्या सरकार वाड्यातील गणपती' असे उल्लेखले आहे.
significance_short: Inside Shaniwarwada's ramparts — Ganesh Gate (Ganesh Darwaja) is named after this temple. One of the most historically significant Ganesh sites in Pune. Peshwa-era records document it.
idol_description: Traditional Ganesh idol within the historic ramparts of Shaniwarwada. The Ganesh Gate of Shaniwarwada is directly adjacent — deeply connected to Peshwa history.
mandir_address: Along Shaniwarwada ramparts (south-east corner), Kasba Peth, Pune 411011
pandal_address: Permanent temple site; access during Shaniwarwada visit
special_events: Combined Shaniwarwada heritage visit; Ganesh Gate historical significance

history_english: Phadke Haud Ganpati is named after the historic Phadke Haud (Phadke water tank) in Kasba Peth — one of Pune's oldest neighbourhoods. The haud (tank) was historically used by the community for daily water needs. The address of the Kasba Ganpati temple is 159, Kasba Peth Road, Durvankur Society, Phadke Haud — meaning this mandal sits directly in the neighbourhood of the 1st Manacha. It is part of the natural circuit devotees follow when visiting the Kasba Peth area.
history_marathi: फडके हौद गणपती कसबा पेठेतील ऐतिहासिक फडके हौदाजवळ आहे. हौद म्हणजे पाण्याची टाकी. पहिल्या मानाच्या कसबा गणपतीच्या परिसरातच असल्याने दर्शन फेरीत नैसर्गिकपणे येते.
significance_short: Named after historic Phadke water tank in Kasba Peth. Same neighbourhood as 1st Manacha Kasba Ganpati. Old Pune community-style celebration.
idol_description: Traditional idol in heritage Kasba Peth neighbourhood setting. Narrow old wadas and lanes of Kasba Peth form the atmosphere.

special_events: Part of Kasba Peth neighbourhood circuit; community festival style; near Kasba Ganpati temple

history_english: Trishund Mayureshwar Ganapati is a Peshwa-era temple featuring a rare iconographic form of Ganesha: three trunks (Trishund) and six arms, seated on a peacock (Mayureshwar). This form of Ganesha is celebrated for its mysticism and artistic rarity. 'Trishund' means three-trunked and 'Mayureshwar' means the lord who rides a peacock — a form associated with Ganesha's avatar at Morgaon (one of the Ashtavinayak). The specific location within Pune needs verification.

significance_short: Rare three-trunked (Trishund) Ganesha seated on a peacock — extremely rare iconographic form. Peshwa-era architectural gem.
idol_description: Three-trunked, six-armed Ganesha idol seated on a peacock. Extremely rare iconographic form — one of the few such temples in Pune or Maharashtra.

history_english: Chimnya Ganapati is one of the historic Ganesh temples of Sadashiv Peth listed in Wikipedia's entry on Sadashiv Peth. It is a Peshwa-era temple in the neighbourhood known for its cultural and intellectual character. Several other major mandals (Nimbalkar Talim, Tambe Mandal) are located nearby, making this part of the Sadashiv Peth Ganpati circuit.

history_english: Umbrya Ganapati is another historic Ganesh temple of Sadashiv Peth, mentioned alongside Chimnya Ganapati in records of the neighbourhood's temples. The name 'Umbrya' likely refers to a fig (umbar) tree historically associated with the temple's location — a common feature of old Pune's Ganesh temples. It forms part of the Sadashiv Peth Ganpati heritage circuit.
history_marathi: उंब्र्या गणपती हे सदाशिव पेठेतील एक ऐतिहासिक गणेश मंदिर आहे. 'उंब्र्या' हे नाव उंबराच्या झाडाशी संबंधित असावे — जुन्या पुण्यातील मंदिरांमध्ये उंबराच्या झाडाचे अनन्यसाधारण महत्त्व होते.
significance_short: Peshwa-era temple in Sadashiv Peth. Name likely linked to a historic fig (umbar) tree at the site — a common old Pune temple tradition.

The mandal emphasises classical music, religious recitations, and culturally rooted programs over spectacular decoration. It represents the refined festival culture of old Sadashiv Peth.

idol_description: Traditional Ganesh idol with emphasis on religious and cultural authenticity.
mandir_address: Sadashiv Peth, Pune 411030

history_english: Akhil Navi Peth Hatti Ganpati Mandal is famous for its Visarjan procession — the first and last day processions are particularly renowned, with dhol-tasha pathak (drum troupe) leading the parade. The mandal celebrated 125 years of existence (as of around 2017), making it one of Pune's oldest mandals. Their pandal once replicated a Ganesh Mahal for the 125th anniversary. The procession is known for its energy and scale.
history_marathi: अखिल नवी पेठ हत्ती गणपती मंडळाची विसर्जन मिरवणूक विशेष प्रसिद्ध आहे. ढोल-ताशा पथकासह पहिल्या आणि शेवटच्या दिवसाची मिरवणूक प्रेक्षणीय असते. मंडळाने १२५ वर्षे पूर्ण केले होते.
significance_short: Famous for energetic Visarjan procession with dhol-tasha pathak. One of Pune's oldest mandals (125+ years). Ganesh Mahal-replica pandal on 125th anniversary.
idol_description: Traditional Ganpati idol within creative themed pandals. Procession energy is the main draw.

history_english: Gajanan Ganpati Mandal is notable for its unique tradition of taking the Visarjan procession jointly with Garud Ganpati Mandal on a single rath (chariot), creating an impressive combined spectacle during immersion. 'Gajanan' is one of Lord Ganesha's names, meaning elephant-faced. The mandal participates in the high-energy Laxmi Road procession corridor.

history_english: Kasba Peth Talim Ganpati is one of the neighbourhood mandals of Kasba Peth, rooted in the talim (traditional wrestling gymnasium) culture that was historically central to Maharashtra's community life. Talimai (gymnasium communities) traditionally maintained strong neighbourhood bonds and used Ganeshotsav as a platform for community gathering. Located in the same neighbourhood as the 1st Manacha Kasba Ganpati.

The area is home to the Jotyachi Talim Mandal (known for 12 Jyotirlinga replica). The neighbourhood's community mandal celebrates Ganeshotsav in the peth's traditional style.

Shivajinagar is also the location of the busy Shivajinagar bus stand and Pune civil courts area, giving the mandal high natural footfall.

history_english: Chinchwad Devasthan is associated with Moraya Gosavi — the great 17th-century saint-devotee of Lord Ganesha whose family lineage became the hereditary priests of the Ashtavinayak circuit. Moraya Gosavi moved to Chinchwad from Morgaon and established his ashram here. The Chinchwad Devasthan houses the samadhi (tomb) of Moraya Gosavi and is directly connected to the Mayureshwar Ganpati Temple at Morgaon — the first of the Ashtavinayak. The Chinchwad Devasthan Trust also manages the Morgaon temple. A palkhi (palanquin) procession from Chinchwad to Morgaon is a major annual event.
history_marathi: चिंचवड देवस्थान मोरया गोसावींशी संबंधित आहे — गणेशभक्त संत जे अष्टविनायक परंपरेचे मुख्य उपासक होते. मोरया गोसावींनी मोरगावहून चिंचवडला आश्रम स्थापला. येथे त्यांची समाधी आहे. चिंचवड देवस्थान ट्रस्ट मोरगावचे मयूरेश्वर मंदिरही चालवते. पालखी सोहळा प्रसिद्ध आहे.
significance_short: Samadhi of Moraya Gosavi — the great Ganesha saint who established the Ashtavinayak tradition. Chinchwad Devasthan Trust manages Morgaon's Mayureshwar temple. Palkhi procession to Morgaon is famous.
idol_description: Ancient temple complex with samadhi of Moraya Gosavi. Deeply connected to the Ashtavinayak pilgrimage circuit.

history_english: Pune Camp (Cantonment) is the colonial-era neighbourhood of Pune, distinct in character from the old peths. The Ganpati mandal(s) here reflect the multicultural, cosmopolitan character of the Camp area — home to a mix of Maharashtrian, non-Maharashtrian, and expatriate residents. The celebration here tends to be more accessible to visitors unfamiliar with the old peths and is known for organised, well-managed pandals.
